_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 53 windows moving ±2+ points and no visible breaker in the divergence stack, the coil persists at Denial until either fear_greed breaks below 20 (cascading into Panic) or momentum + funding + netflow align for a genuine breakout into Disbelief.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the narrative leans toward an eventual upside snap while the analyst insists HOLD with no directional bias; consensus sides with the analyst's base-rate discipline
next_move.confirmed_if: Score remains in 32-38 band over next 12-24h with no ±2 point displacement
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks below 20 (panic acceleration downward) OR btc_momentum_30d breaks above 65 with funding sustaining above 0.01% and exchange_netflow dropping below 80 (genuine breakout upward)
